title: Earliest known potter's wheel
summary: A potter's wheel from the Cucuteni-Trypillia culture predates those in Mesopotamia. Where the wheel was first invented remains unclear.
why: Rotary motion for making pots, a forerunner of wheeled machines.

notes.problem: 'Tournettes c. 3500 BCE' not in source and not shown independent; source says only that potter's wheels were used in the 4th millennium BCE Middle East.
